pumac-2013-algebra-b-01.prompt:
Suppose $a,b,c>0$ are integers such that
$$abc-bc-ac-ab+a+b+c=2013.$$
Find the number of possibilities for the ordered triple $(a,b,c)$.

pumac-2013-algebra-b-02.prompt: Betty Lou and Peggy Sue take turns flipping switches on a $100\times100$ grid. Initially, all switches are "off." Betty Lou always flips a horizontal row of switches on her turn; Peggy Sue always flips a vertical column of switches. When they finish, there is an odd number of switches turned "on" in each row and column. Find the maximum number of switches that can be on, in total, when they finish.

pumac-2013-algebra-b-03.prompt:
Let $x_1=\frac1{20}$, $x_2=\frac1{13}$, and
$$x_{n+2}=\frac{2x_nx_{n+1}(x_n+x_{n+1})}{x_n^2+x_{n+1}^2}$$
for all integers $n\ge1$. Evaluate $\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac1{x_n+x_{n+1}}$.

pumac-2013-algebra-b-04.prompt:
Let $f(x)=1-|x|$. Let
$$f_n(x)=(\underbrace{f\circ\cdots\circ f}_{n\text{ copies}})(x),\qquad g_n(x)=\big|n-|x|\big|.$$
Determine the area of the region bounded by the $x$-axis and the graph of the function $\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^{10}f_n(x)+\sum_{n=1}^{10}g_n(x)$.

pumac-2013-algebra-b-05.prompt: Find the number of pairs $(n,C)$ of positive integers such that $C\le 100$ and $n^2+n+C$ is a perfect square.

pumac-2013-algebra-b-06.prompt: Suppose $a,b$ are nonzero integers such that two roots of $x^3+ax^2+bx+9a$ coincide, and all three roots are integers. Find $|ab|$.

pumac-2013-algebra-b-08.prompt:
If $x,y$ are real, then the absolute value of the complex number $z=x+iy$ is $|z|=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$.

Find the number of polynomials $f(t)=A_0+A_1t+A_2t^2+A_3t^3+t^4$ such that $A_0,\dots,A_3$ are integers and all roots of $f$ in the complex plane have absolute value $\le1$.
